live.intro.zh-CN: 三个条件同时满足才会开启：进程开关 CORRIDOR_LIVE=1、按路径读取的凭据文件、评委访问码；另须设置运行日志目录 LIVE_JOURNAL_DIR。默认关闭；关闭且本会话从未开启时，控制器使用原脚本规划器对象，页面多一枚徽标。从开启状态关闭时，新的请求立即不再发给模型，进行中的办理到交易边界才换回脚本。访问码在浏览器内与一次性挑战做哈希，组件只把这一证明发给服务器（须在 HTTPS 或本机地址打开页面）。
live.intro.en: Three conditions at once: the process switch CORRIDOR_LIVE=1, a credential file read by path, and the judges' access code; a journal directory (LIVE_JOURNAL_DIR) must be set too. Off by default; when off and never switched on in this session, the controller keeps the original scripted planner object and the page adds a badge. When switched off after being on, new requests stop going to the model at once, and an open transaction returns to the scripted planner at its boundary. The access code is hashed in your browser with a single-use challenge; the field sends only that proof to the server (open the page over HTTPS or on this machine).

live.customer.intro.en: The real AI model needs the judges' access code; the scripted demo is used by default.

live.reserve.zh-CN: 每次调用先按假设价预留约 {amount} {currency}（{tokens} 个输入 token + 输出上限 {output}）；发送前客户端按整个请求体的字节数另算上界，超过预留即不发送。结算分五种：没有发出，释放预留；有有效用量，按实际结算；已发出但没有用量（超时、网络错误），按发送前上界结算，不按零；无法判断，整笔预留保留；结算失败，预留保留、下一次调用前重新核验台账（若用量又超过预留，台账可能低估，所有会话停止实时调用直到托管方核对）。这是按假设价的预算守卫，不是提供商账单的硬上限；剩余额度不足一次预留即视为已达上限。
live.reserve.en: Each call first reserves about {amount} {currency} at the assumed prices ({tokens} input tokens + the {output}-token output cap); before sending, the client bounds the whole request by its bytes and does not send one whose bound exceeds the reservation. Settlement has five outcomes: not sent, the reservation is released; valid usage, settled at the actual cost; sent without usage (a timeout, a network error), settled at its pre-send bound, never at zero; unclear, the whole reservation is kept; settlement failed, the reservation is kept and the ledger is checked again before the next call (if usage also exceeded the reservation the ledger may be too low, and every session stops live calls until the operator reconciles it). This is a budget guard at assumed prices, not a provider's hard billing limit; when less than one reservation is left, the cap counts as reached.

live.no_secret.zh-CN: 组件不向服务器发送明文访问码；服务器只收到一次性挑战的证明，核对后即从会话中删除。访问码须为至少 20 位、由密码学随机源生成的串（短码可能被拿到证明的人离线猜出）。密钥按路径从凭据文件读取，每次调用时读入、调用结束即清除；在所测场景下（成功、401、超时、格式失败、录制失败与结算失败，哨兵值逐项扫描），调用之间的会话对象、页面、运行日志、结果索引与台账里没有扫描到密钥或访问码。调用进行中密钥在该次请求的客户端对象里；这不是内存可靠清零的承诺。
live.no_secret.en: The field never sends the access code itself: the server receives only a proof for a single-use challenge and deletes it from the session once checked. The access code must be a string of at least 20 characters from a cryptographic random source (a short code could be guessed offline by anyone holding a proof). The key is read from the credential file by path for each call and cleared when the call returns; in the tested outcomes (success, 401, timeout, format failure, record failure and settlement failure, scanned for sentinel values) neither the key nor the code was found in the session objects between calls, the page, the journal, the outcome index or the ledger. During a call the key is in that request's client object; this is not a promise that memory is wiped.

live.customer.no_secret.zh-CN: 访问码在您的浏览器里与一次性挑战做哈希，组件不向服务器发送明文访问码，页面与运行记录里也不保存它。
live.customer.no_secret.en: The access code is hashed in your browser with a single-use challenge; the field never sends the code itself to the server, and neither the page nor the run records keep it.

live.reason_of.live-revoked.zh-CN: 实时模型已停用（开关关闭、访问撤销或凭据变更），请求未发出

live.note.partly_scripted.en: Live model timed out: {count} step(s) of this reply came from the scripted rules (the client's own timeout fallback), not from the model.
live.note.partly_scripted.zh-CN: 实时模型超时：本次回复有 {count} 步由脚本规则代答（客户端既有的超时回退），不全是模型输出。

live.note.calls.en: Live calls behind this reply: {calls} (recorded {recorded} · timed out and answered by scripts {timeouts} · refused by the page's checks {rejected})
live.note.calls.zh-CN: 本条回复的实时调用：{calls} 次（录制 {recorded} 次 · 超时由脚本代答 {timeouts} 次 · 输出被页面核对拒绝 {rejected} 次）

live.note.settlement_failed.en: Cost settlement failed: this call's cost could not be written to the ledger, which keeps the reservation made before the call (not less than the actual cost at the assumed prices); the ledger is checked again before the next live call.
live.note.settlement_failed.zh-CN: 费用结算异常：本次调用的费用未能写入台账，台账保留调用前的预留（不少于按假设价的实际费用）；下一次实时调用前会重新核验台账。

live.note.overrun.en: The provider reported more usage than the pre-send bound: the ledger records the actual cost and this session has stopped live calls.
live.note.overrun.zh-CN: 提供商报告的用量超过了发送前的上界：台账按实际费用记账，本会话已停止实时调用。

live.note.wealth_scripted.en: The wealth goal is parsed by scripted rules: the wealth advisor is not connected to the live model; only the intent classification went to it.
live.note.wealth_scripted.zh-CN: 理财目标由脚本规则解析：理财顾问未接实时模型，本条只有意图分类经过实时模型。

live.note.clarify.en: This reply asks you to clarify: whenever the model's output disagrees with the local trusted parse or details are missing, the page asks instead of acting on the model's output.
live.note.clarify.zh-CN: 本条为请您澄清：模型输出与本地可信解析不一致或信息不足时，页面一律改为澄清，不按模型输出办理。

live.note.unreconciled.zh-CN: 费用待核对：提供商报告的用量超过了调用前的预留，而这次的费用又未能写入台账，台账可能低估实际费用；在托管方核对之前，所有会话都不再发起实时调用。
live.note.unreconciled.en: Cost to be reconciled: the provider reported more usage than the reservation made before the call, and this call's cost could not be written to the ledger, so the ledger may be lower than the real cost; no session makes live calls until the operator reconciles it.

live.reason.weak_code.zh-CN: 配置的访问码太短或太简单（少于 20 位，或不同字符少于 8 种），实时模型不可用：请托管方用密码学随机源生成访问码（例如 secrets.token_urlsafe(24)）。
live.reason.weak_code.en: The configured access code is too short or too simple (fewer than 20 characters, or fewer than 8 different ones), so live access is unavailable: the operator should generate it from a cryptographic random source (for example secrets.token_urlsafe(24)).

live.reason.ledger_unreconciled.zh-CN: 花费台账待核对（有一次调用的用量超过预留且费用未能记账），所有会话的实时调用已停止，需托管方核对后清除。
live.reason.ledger_unreconciled.en: The spend ledger awaits reconciliation (one call's usage exceeded its reservation and its cost could not be recorded): live calls are stopped for every session until the operator reconciles it.

live.reason_of.ledger-unreconciled.zh-CN: 花费台账待核对，请求未发出
live.reason_of.ledger-unreconciled.en: the spend ledger awaits reconciliation, so the request was not sent
